outbox.cancelled: That message was taken back and will not be sent.
outbox.failed: That message did not send. Check it and try again.
outbox.io: The message list could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
outbox.notFound: That message is no longer in the list.
outbox.staleRevision: That message changed. Look again before acting on it.
outbox.tooLate: That message was already handed to the sender and cannot be taken back.
outbox.unavailable: Sending is not set up for this list.
outbox.unknown: That message was being sent when the app stopped. Check whether it arrived before sending it again.
